title: Charge test-effect mismatch while preserving a genuine positive use refinement
statement: Assume actual USE has positive Pauli branches with nonidentity effect W and actual TEST effect F>=f*I+nu*W-epsilon*I uniformly on the complete current memory, 0<nu<=1. Privately TEST with predictable p in(0,1). For fixed z>1 choose a=1-(1-p)*(z-1)/(p*nu) in(0,1) and c=1-p*(f-epsilon)*(1-a)>0. Then the weighted one-step effect is at most c*I. With virtual USE count B_n, M_n=z^B_n*product_TEST(a_i^A_i)/product_i(c_i) is a nonnegative supermartingale. On one event of probability at least1-delta, all prefixes satisfy B_n<=[ln(1/delta)+sum_i ln(c_i)-sum_TEST A_i ln(a_i)]/ln(z).

requires: A genuine positive refinement of the actual USE map and a uniform full-memory operator relation for the actual TEST effect on every possible current/refined state.
Predictable parameters p_i,f_i,nu_i,epsilon_i with 0<nu_i<=1, one fixed z>1, 0<a_i<1,c_i>0; fresh private role choice conditioned on allowed history; 0<delta<1.

assumptions: A fitted failure rate on one bath state is not the required operator inequality.
Coherent/bias leakage in USE can remove the positive virtual count even if a norm discrepancy is small; no stochastic reinterpretation is supplied.
costs: Charge all tests/uses, mismatch risk credits, admission stopping, private randomness and complete-boundary uniform calibration. The source ninety-run throughput comparisons are not replayed or hardware values.
contract.units: p,a,c,nu,epsilon,f,delta,z,effects and count/risk budgets are dimensionless. A virtual count is not a measured microscopic error history.
contract.obstruction: Acquire the actual positive USE and complete-boundary effect calibration before applying the online budget; pay terminal errors separately.

body: Use the exact positive refinement, not an invented latent error label for a coherent channel. The USE contribution is(1-p)[I+(z-1)W]; the TEST contribution is p[I-(1-a)F]. Substituting the uniform operator lower bound cancels W because p*nu*(1-a)=(1-p)*(z-1), leaving cI. It remains valid on every refined prior branch, without a bath dimension, reset or Markov assumption. A conditional predictable test coin must stay independent of the current hidden state/role side channels. Ville bounds the entire nonnegative product process; failure probability is not paid independently at every time. For U_n the displayed bound, V0=0 and V_n=min(U_n,V_(n-1)+1_USE) transports earlier information since the latent count grows by at most1 per actual USE. Admit a next candidate only if V_n+1<=Bmax to bound admitted virtual-fault prefixes on that same event. At f=0, c=1+p*(1-a)*epsilon; repeated mismatch accumulates sum ln c and can force early stopping. The statistical result does not require TEST to share the ideal coarse memory-update map; all retained data belong in its actual complete boundary and uniform calibration. Exact coarse instruments supply nu=2/3,f=epsilon=0. A coherent/bias change in USE that destroys its positive refinement cannot be paid merely by this TEST-effect epsilon; a separately justified finite-block channel allowance is different. No conditional output fidelity, individual fault identification, code independence, future-safe output or unlimited availability follows.
